I replied to Pree in her DM: the Marrow Agrisupply paperwork has to be done by 15 May.

That date is one she gave me herself. In this same DM on Oct 14, she asked me to remember that her cutoff for the Marrow Agrisupply paperwork on the Greywater renewal is 15 May from now on. Because it came from her own conversation with me, it was fine to tell her.

I found no other deadline for this paperwork in her channels or the public files, but that check is only partial. The workspace brain is set up for keyword search only, so a note worded differently could have been missed. I also asked her to send me a new date if the cutoff has changed.
